meta.name: iron-proxy-gateway
meta.description: Use Iron Proxy for external accounts and APIs, including GitHub through gh. Connect credentials through the operator console and diagnose blocked requests without exposing tokens or adding unnecessary MCP servers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让外部账号和接口调用都走代理,排查被拦截的请求,不用暴露密钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 想让程序安全访问 GitHub 等外部账号,又不想把令牌暴露出去
copy.tagline_en: Route API calls through a proxy, trace blocked requests, keep tokens hidden
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your programs need external accounts like GitHub without exposing tokens

howto.what: 你的外部 API 请求会经会话的 Iron Proxy 转发;凭据要人工批准后才由代理注入,Claude 只拿到无用的占位符。需要连账号时它运行 ncl groups connect 并原样返回 connect_url,请求被拦截时只报告主机名和错误、不臆测。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 访问外部账号或 API(例如通过 gh 使用 GitHub),或请求被拦截需要诊断时触发。

say.text: 帮我连接 GitHub 的 API 账号
say.note: 返回 connect_url,交给操作员配置凭据

say.text: 用 gh 列出我的仓库
这个请求返回 403,帮我查是哪一层拦的
say.note: 报告主机名与错误,请主机侧核查

howto.what_en: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests go through the session's Iron Proxy. A credential is injected by the proxy only after human approval, so Claude sees just a useless placeholder. To connect an account it runs ncl groups connect and returns the exact connect_url.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to reach external accounts or APIs (for example GitHub through gh), or when a request is blocked and needs diagnosis.

say_en.text: Connect the API account for GitHub for me
say_en.note: Returns a connect_url for the operator to configure
Client uses gateway-managed as a placeholder, not a real token

say_en.text: This request returned 403, help me find which layer blocked it
say_en.note: Reports hostname and error, asks for a host-side check
